# OpenLF2 for PortMaster

OpenLF2 is an open-source engine for Little Fighter 2 (https://github.com/OpenLF2/OpenLF2).

## Game files

Let the game download the installer on first start (needs a network connection), or copy
`LF2_v2.0a.exe` into `ports/openlf2/conf/`. The settings file `config.json` is kept there too.

## Controls

The game reads the controller directly; set the buttons on its Controls page.
Hotkey + Start quits.
